lines.translation: Pauree:
YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.
Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.
Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;
with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart,
Does not have to take birth again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: yayaa janam na haareeai gur poore kee tek ||
lines.translation: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tih sukh paaiaa jaa kai heearai ek ||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar man tan bas rahe eet oot ke meet ||
lines.translation: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa naanak japeeai neet ||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin simarahu taas kau jo a(n)t sahaaee hoi ||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help and Support in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih bikhiaa din chaar chhi chhaad chalio sabh koi ||
lines.translation: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaa ko maat pitaa sut dheeaa ||
lines.translation: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: grih banitaa kachh sa(n)g na leeaa ||
lines.translation: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.
So gather that wealth which shall never perish,
so that you may go to your true home with honor.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te te bahur na aaiaa ||15||
lines.translation: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: at su(n)dar kuleen chatur mukh ngiaanee dhanava(n)t ||
lines.translation: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: miratak kaheeahi naanakaa jih preet nahee bhagava(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ||1||
Pauree:
NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.
He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.
He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.
He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam sa(n)g man nahee hetaa ||
lines.translation: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,
then everything he does is transitory.
Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,
O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)t chaar dah dis bhrame karam kirat kee rekh ||
lines.translation: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the dictates of his karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sookh dookh mukat jon naanak likhio lekh ||1||
lines.translation: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Pauree:
KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.
Nothing can be done a second time.
The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.
To some, He Himself shows the Way.
While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.
He Himself has set His own play in motion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo deeno s naanak leeno ||17||
lines.translation: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17||
Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat rahe toot na jaahi bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har japat anek jan naanak naahi sumaar ||1||
lines.translation: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ||1||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਖਾ ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khakhaa khoonaa kachh nahee tis sa(n)mrath kai paahi ||
lines.translation: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo denaa so de rahio bhaavai tah tah jaahi ||
lines.translation: whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kharach khajaanaa naam dhan iaa bhagatan kee raas ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: khimaa gareebee anad sahaj japat rahahi gunataas ||
lines.translation: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: khelahi bigasahi anad siu jaa kau hot kripaal ||
lines.translation: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadeev ganeev suhaavane raam naam grihi maal ||
lines.translation: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khed na dookh na daan tih jaa kau nadar karee ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa pooree tinaa paree ||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18||
